concerns.text: Task T009_calc is marked as missing (unchecked) and references an unresolved claim placeholder `{{claim:c_678f0254}}` for the theoretical lower bound formula. This leaves FR-008 (compute theoretical lower bound) and SC-002 (measure against bound) without an implementable task, as the formula required to derive the bound is absent.

Task T017c (Unified Data Generation) is marked as missing (unchecked). This task is the sole implementation of FR-001 (generate 10,000 synthetic matrices) and US-1. Without this task, the ground-truth dataset required for US-2 and US-3 cannot be generated.

Task T046 (Create unified entry point `code/main.py`) is marked as missing. The quickstart/plan implies a single entry point for the full pipeline, and T045 explicitly flags the missing `code/main.py` as a run-book mismatch. Without T046, the orchestration of US-1, US-2, and US-3 is incomplete.

Task T047 (Update `docs/quickstart.md`) is marked as missing. This task is required to resolve the run-book mismatch identified in T045 and T046, ensuring the documentation reflects the actual execution path (`python -m code.main`). Without it, the quickstart instructions remain broken.

Task T048 (Add integration test for `code.main`) is marked as missing. This task is necessary to verify the orchestration logic of the new entry point (T046) without incurring full runtime costs, ensuring the pipeline is testable as per the plan's verification strategy.
